changes: Scribe confidence lowered from high to medium: the cataloguer's parentheses in 'viśva(la)jana' mark the syllable 'la' as uncertain, so the name could be Viśvalajana or Viśvajana
Notes expanded: the era is not named in the colophon, and no tithi is given

notes: The colophon gives only 'samvat 790' without naming the era. Reading it as NS (790 + 880 = c. 1670 CE) fits the Newari script and the catalogue. As VS it would be far too early. The scribe's name is written viśva(la)jana; the cataloguer's parentheses probably mark 'la' as uncertain, so the name may be Viśvajana. Śivācārya is taken as a title or caste name (a Śaiva priest). No tithi is given, only Vaiśākha kṛṣṇa.
